description: Same as postmd_update_document, but reads the new Markdown from filePath on the machine running this MCP server. Takes `controlToken` the same way.

clearShareEndDate.description: true removes the end date, making sharing open-ended.

controlToken.description: Control token from an anonymous publish answer (pmt_...). Lets you act on that one document without an API key.

fileName.description: Upload filename. Defaults to the basename of filePath.

filePath.description: Path to a .md file on the MCP server host, read as UTF-8. Prefer an absolute path.

notesOnReplace.description: Required when replacing the content. Notes are located by the text they quote, so replacing the body moves or loses where they point: a note whose quote is gone loses its place in the body, and one whose quote now appears elsewhere points there. keep replaces anyway and leaves the notes. abort refuses when the document has notes anchored to its text, and the answer says how many.

password.description: Readers must supply this password to see the content.

shareEndDate.description: yyyyMMdd. The document stops being served after this date. Omit for no end date.

viewerStyle.description: Viewer theme: readable (default), github, minimal, report, pamphlet or dark. Unknown values fall back to readable.

name: postmd_update_document_from_file
